United KingdomUnited StatesDeutschlandFranceEspañaItaliaInternationalSelect a countryUnited KingdomUnited StatesDeutschlandFranceEspañaItaliaInternationalMenuPublic dataSolutionsCompanyPanelist supportContact salesSearchLog inSign upHow popular is Donald Trump in Europe? October 2026YouGov -November 5, 2026YouGov European tracker series looks at Donald Trump's popularity in Britain, Denmark, France, Germany, Italy and SpainHow popular is Donald Trump in Britain?October’s tracker poll finds that 10% of Britons have a favourable opinion of Donald Trump and 86% have an unfavourable opinion. These scores are within the margin of error of those for September’s survey, and therefore represent little change.

Donald Trump's net favourability score of -76 in Britain is his lowest since YouGov started tracking this question in March 2025.

October’s tracker poll finds that 12% of French have a favourable opinion of Donald Trump and 83% have an unfavourable opinion. This represents a slight decrease in popularity since September’s survey, with the number of French holding a favourable view remaining largely the same but the number with an unfavourable view rising by four points.

Donald Trump's net favourability score of -71 in France is his lowest since YouGov started tracking this question in March 2025.

October’s tracker poll finds that 11% of Germans have a favourable opinion of Donald Trump and 85% have an unfavourable opinion. These scores are within the margin of error of those for September’s survey, and therefore represent little change.

October’s tracker poll finds that 7% of Italians have a favourable opinion of Donald Trump and 85% have an unfavourable opinion. These scores are within the margin of error of those for September’s survey, and therefore represent little change.

October’s tracker poll finds that 10% of Spaniards have a favourable opinion of Donald Trump and 87% have an unfavourable opinion. These scores are within the margin of error of those for September’s survey, and therefore represent little change.

Donald Trump's net favourability score of -77 in Spain is his lowest since YouGov started tracking this question in March 2025.

October’s tracker poll finds that 3% of Danes have a favourable opinion of Donald Trump and 96% have an unfavourable opinion. These scores are within the margin of error of those for September’s survey, and therefore represent little change.

Donald Trump's net favourability score of -93 in Denmark is his lowest since YouGov started tracking this question in March 2025.
